title: U.S. intensifies sanctions against Iran and increases tension in the Middle East
summary: Washington announces 'total economic war' and expands secondary sanctions, while Houthis attack oil tankers in the Red Sea and markets react.

title: Dow Jones rises 140 points and yen falls to 159 per dollar as yields and oil fall
summary: New York stocks chain gains supported by falling long-term rates and crude, while dollar strengthens on tension with Iran.

title: SoftBank Group issues 1 trillion yen in retail bonds, largest domestic issuance, to accelerate AI investment
summary: The placement, the largest in Japan's history, aims to finance the bet on artificial intelligence and attracts retail investors despite market caution.

title: Major 'konbini' chains lower onigiri prices as rice cost falls
summary: Lawson and other companies reduce rice ball prices reflecting the drop in cereal prices in the wholesale market.

title: Twenty years since fatal drunk driving accident in Fukuoka: mother of three victims remembers loss in poem
summary: The accident, in which three children died, spurred the 'accomplice offense' but alcohol-related accidents persist.

title: Typhoon 18 approaches Okinawa and Amami with very intense strength and risk of dangerous waves
summary: Meteorological agency warns of hurricane-force winds, torrential rains, and storm surges that could prolong effects for several days.

title: One thousand people pull ropes to return Hirosaki Castle tower to its original position
summary: The 400-ton structure was displaced years ago by construction work and now citizens participate in its historic return.

title: Professional Shintaro Hattori, 27, wins right to challenge champion Sota Fujii for Ryuo title
summary: Hattori, in his second chance at a major title, won the decisive third game of the challenge series.

title: United States removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism after 47 years
summary: The measure aims to facilitate private investment and marks a shift in policy toward Damascus after nearly five decades of isolation.

title: Tourists seeking street prostitution in Japan increase and debate grows over punishing clients
summary: Authorities study penalizing solicitation of sexual services to curb deterioration of safety in areas like Kabukicho.

title: Tamon Watanuki, former House of Representatives speaker and key figure in Japanese politics, dies at 99
summary: Known for his opposition to postal privatization in the Koizumi era, he was temporarily expelled from the LDP and later regained his seat.
